spec: Extra-wide 3:1 panoramic background for a Korean wizard life-growth game. Refined 16-bit pixel art, layered side-scrolling landscape, continuous ground or open flight space. No characters, text, UI, borders or watermarks. Characters rendered separately.

assets.scene: deep outer space and Earth horizon

night.prompt: Create the NIGHT version of this exact pixel-art game background. Preserve the exact extra-wide 3:1 panoramic composition, geometry, terrain, architecture, ground height, foreground walking surface, camera, pixel scale and all scene identity. Change ONLY lighting and sky to a restful moonlit night: deep desaturated navy and indigo, readable soft blue moonlight on path and scenery, delicate stars where sky is visible, subtle warm lights in inhabited buildings/windows. For the space station keep Earth and stars visible and lower interior lighting softly. NOT pitch black: foreground should remain clearly legible behind a character. No people, no characters, no creatures, no vehicles, no text, no UI or border. Full bleed panoramic background, same dimensions/aspect as reference.

characters.modern: Same identity, face, hair and pixel style; remove hat/staff, modern navy/teal jacket for male, plum/coral jacket for female, trousers and sneakers, crossbody bag, small jewel pendant. Transparent single-character sprite.
characters.rest: Same wizard identity and costume; eyes closed, seated resting on small travel blanket, transparent single-character sprite.

wastelandTent.prompt: Transparent pixel-art beige camping tent in three-quarter view, sleeping wizard on cream pillow under blanket, warm lantern, cool moonlight edges. Same tent composition for both genders; male navy blanket and black hair, female plum blanket and purple hair/coral hat.
wastelandTent.cleanup: Built-in image_gen exterior-haze cleanup, followed by CSS silhouette clipping; simple hand resting on blanket; female bare head with one hat beside pillow. Night subjects brightness .72 and saturation .78; localized warm lantern glow.

meadowSleep.description: Male and female lying on backs on meadow, hands on belly, original adventurer outfits and boots from idle-standing references, single enlarged hat beside head, transparent pixel-art sprites.

forestSleep.description: Moonlit forest interior, male/female in original outfits sleeping seated against mossy tree base, hat and bag beside roots, blue/purple gem staff leaning alongside.
